sources.title: GitHub - google-research/byt5
sources.snippet: ByT5 is a tokenizer-free extension of the mT5 model. Instead of using a subword vocabulary like most other pretrained language models (BERT, XLM-R, T5, GPT-3), our ByT5 model operates directly on UTF-8 bytes, removing the need for any text preprocessing.
